render_registration.measurement_note: Explicit foot/support anchor; body scale is independent of long-tail extent. Alpha>=8 visible bounds; original pixels and full tail retained.

style_policy.note: Reference rendering policy, not a claim that a generated bitmap is pixel-identical at arbitrary future scales. Protect species markings, face, beak, toes and spines.

review.anatomy: Pass: v002 is a white-variety rooster with red single comb/wattles, pale legs and individually flowing long white tail feathers. Exterior body/tail contour now matches the family; interior feather lines stay fine. The full tail is retained and body scale is registered separately.
review.style: Pass: reviewed at registered body scale on cream and dark backgrounds, against Tora / existing Little Bird. Natural same-series contours and texture; small individual variation accepted.
review.alpha: Pass: RGBA with alpha range 0..255, no clipped anatomy, visible matte, checkerboard or halo in proper composites. Source pixels retained unchanged.
